seeded_failure.symptom: Kali Linux cannot ping the vulnerable target machine, showing Destination Host Unreachable.
seeded_failure.cause: The target VM's network adapter was left set to NAT instead of being attached to the Host-Only network.
seeded_failure.fix: Change the target VM's network adapter settings in VirtualBox to Host-Only, restart the interface, and re-test connectivity.
